visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Characters: A middle-aged man wearing a blue beanie and a grey-and-white outdoor jacket sits on stone steps, speaking to a woman in a black jacket and a green surgical mask. Micro-actions: The man gestures with his hands while looking up; the woman stands still, listening intently. Objects: A wall behind them is covered with informational posters and maps. Setting: An outdoor urban stairwell area with flat, natural daylight. (2) Characters: The man in the blue beanie stands up and holds a large white board with four color photos. Micro-actions: He points specifically at the photos while addressing the masked woman; a younger woman in a beige fleece jacket and glasses sits nearby, smiling and watching. Objects: The board features four male portraits with names written above them. Setting: The same urban outdoor location with a red door frame visible. (3) Characters: The woman in the green mask is shown in a closer shot. Micro-actions: She laughs enthusiastically, squinting her eyes and tilting her head. Objects: She wears a black jacket with a fur-trimmed hood. Setting: The background wall remains the same, showing architectural details of a building. (4) Characters: The host in the blue beanie is now outdoors in a different location, speaking to an elderly man in a red vest with a yellow lanyard. Micro-actions: The host holds a different board and points at it; the elderly man looks closely and points back. Objects: A white board with a list of four names in blue text. Setting: A wide outdoor plaza in front of a traditional Chinese temple with red pillars and stone carvings. (5) Characters: The host enters an indoor space and shakes hands with a middle-aged woman in a red long-sleeved shirt. Micro-actions: They interact warmly; later, the host drops his head in a mock-dramatic, upset pose while holding a board. Objects: A board with a yellow taxi graphic at the bottom. Setting: The interior of a temple decorated with red lanterns, wooden furniture, and stacks of ceremonial papers.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 木曜塔庫希EP4. [Logo]: 市長4不4. [Subtitle]: 問姨妳認不認識他. [Variety]: 咦... (2) [Subtitle]: 看什麼認識他的? 啊我就跟你說"七俠五義". [Variety]: 七俠五義. (1994年電視劇). (3) [Subtitle]: 七俠五義來來來. 猜猜我是誰? 我是哪一個? [Variety]: 猜猜我是誰? [Logo]: 洪都拉斯, 劉德華, 陳傑憲, 邰照朋. (4) [Subtitle]: 這個啊! 但是他的名字我真真的... "邰照明也不算錯". (5) [Subtitle]: 他是不是演員. 你好. 扳子扳子來了. [Variety]: 扳子扳子來了. (6) [Subtitle]: 有4個名字請你猜猜. 我是哪一個? 邰照盟... "演員邰照明". (7) [Subtitle]: 你好. 我是邰哥. 偶像你好. 謝謝. [Variety]: 偶像你好!! 偶來了!! (8) [Subtitle]: 偶像來問一下. 我是劉德華, 洪都拉斯, 陳傑憲, 還是邰智源. [Variety]: (1)劉德華, (2)洪都拉斯, (3)陳傑憲, (4)邰智源. (9) [Subtitle]: 邰照盟. "偶像邰照明". 把我的名字稍微改過來. [Variety]: 邰照盟. (走心了).

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Vocals & Prosody: A male host delivers high-energy speech with a bright, projected tone and fast speech rate. Music & Tonality: Upbeat, bouncy synthesizer BGM (approx. 120 BPM) in a major key begins playing. Ambient Sound: Low-level outdoor urban hum. Noise/SFX: A digital 'pop' sound effect marks the start of the narration. (2) Vocals & Prosody: The host's pitch variability increases during a quiz interaction. A woman's high-arousal laughter is clearly audible. Music & Tonality: The bouncy synth BGM continues at a steady volume. Ambient Sound: Indoor room tone with slight natural resonance. Noise/SFX: A sharp, metallic 'ding' bell sound effect triggers as the board is presented. (3) Vocals & Prosody: A hard cut leads to the host greeting an elderly man with a friendly, professional tone. The elderly man's voice is deeper and slightly gravelly. Music & Tonality: Comedic BGM continues with consistent texture. Ambient Sound: Outdoor plaza environment with minimal wind floor. Noise/SFX: A synthetic 'whoosh' transition sound separates the scenes. (4) Vocals & Prosody: The host speaks with a middle-aged woman whose voice is sharp and enunciated. She mispronounces a name with rising intonation. The host reacts with mock-strained vocal tension. Music & Tonality: The BGM swells for the comedic climax. Ambient Sound: Indoor temple resonance with noticeable reverb. Noise/SFX: A cartoonish 'fail' sound effect plays at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Interaction 1 -> Interaction 2 -> Interaction 3 -> Comedic Climax
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic street interview segment where a celebrity host tests public recognition. The primary appeal lies in the humorous gap between his actual fame and the interviewees' inability to correctly remember his name, leading to several 'funny fail' moments.
